_comment: Stoneforge Mystic's '{1}{W}, {T}: put an Equipment card from your hand onto the battlefield' must be expressible as a viewer LINE (2026-08-23). The engine has enumerated PutFromHandAbility since the deck was built and LineSpec has had an sfput= verb just as long, but no plan action told the GUI which permanent to click or which verb to write, so the ability was unusable by a human. A self-driving sweep never reaches the state (an untapped, unsick Stoneforge with an Equipment still in hand), which is exactly why this is a hand-built fixture. env pins human-play mode because that is what the viewer runs.
